name: AIRNOVA
shortDescription: The premier collegiate Drone & Aerospace Engineering Committee dedicated to autonomous UAVs, aeronautics, and aerospace systems.
fullDescription: Airnova is an elite collegiate engineering organization bringing together passionate minds to design, fabricate, test, and fly high-performance unmanned aerial vehicles, rocketry, and biomimetic flight platforms.

vision.title: Our Vision
highlights: Cultivate the next generation of aerospace innovators and UAV engineers.
Push the frontiers of biomimetic flight, autonomous avionics, and high-efficiency aerostructures.
Represent our institution at prestigious national and international aerospace design challenges.

mission.title: Our Mission
highlights: Bridge theoretical engineering with hands-on multidisciplinary airframe prototyping.
Foster open collaboration across structural, propulsion, avionics, and software subsystems.
Deliver mission-critical aerospace hardware with rigorous safety and flight-test protocols.
